landing.heroTitleA: Ask about a disease. Get an answer you can
landing.heroText: Swasth answers questions on dengue, diabetes, TB and more, using only WHO and Indian government health sources. It tells you where each answer came from, in English or Hindi.
landing.guestNote: No sign-up needed. Not a doctor, and it never diagnoses.
landing.previewQuestion: What are the early signs of dengue?
landing.previewAnswer: Dengue usually starts 4 to 10 days after a mosquito bite, with sudden high fever, severe headache, pain behind the eyes, and joint and muscle aches. A rash may follow.
landing.previewDisclaimer: General information only. See a doctor if symptoms are severe.
landing.topicsSubtitle: Each page covers symptoms, prevention, myths and when to see a doctor, with sources shown.
landing.howTitle: It only says what the sources say
landing.step1Text: Type a question in English or Hindi, in your own words.
landing.step2Text: Swasth searches a library of verified WHO and Indian government health documents.
landing.step3Text: Every answer links back to the document it came from, so you can check it yourself.
landing.ctaText: Ask in your own words. You will see exactly where the answer comes from.
